shared_or_similar_visual_information: A dashed segment ending at a right-angle box.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It constructs the perpendicular height from the apex to the base. Right image: It constructs the perpendicular distance from C to AD.
Rationales: Each dashed construction joins a vertex to a base or side and reaches it at a marked right angle. The dashes identify an auxiliary perpendicular height.
